subject: Logic
title: Minimax Regret
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Minimax Regret.

hook.text: You packed an umbrella on a sunny day. Annoying—but imagine the regret of getting soaked without one.

buildup.text: Minimax regret: choose the option that minimizes your worst-case regret across all possible outcomes.

discovery.text: For each option, calculate: how bad would I feel if this turned out wrong? Pick the least-regrettable choice.

twist.text: It doesn't optimize for winning—it protects against the most painful what-if scenario.

climax.text: When you can't estimate probabilities, minimizing regret is a psychologically robust strategy.

quiz.question: What does the minimax regret strategy optimize?
